title: Choose runtime and governance
alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  14 INTEGRATION ARCHITECTURE Choose runtime and governance Two independent choices. The same Verify API destination. 01  WHERE DOES CAPTURE EXECUTE? Backend service Existing request path AWS Lambda Event-driven function Container / ECS Long-running service Queue worker Asynchronous processing 02  HOW IS CAPTURE GOVERNED? Direct integration A direct submission path, commonly used for evaluation. Customer runtime Verify API Governed integration Customer policy is evaluated before transmission. Runtime Customer proxy + policies Verify API The queue, worker and proxy remain customer-owned. Use the runtime that fits the workflow and the governance pattern its review obligations require. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
editorial_note: Reorganizes the original 4×2 matrix into independent runtime and governance choices. Avoids suggesting direct integration is forbidden in production.
